name: Runway
summary: AI video generation and editing platform for creators and studios.
description: Runway is an AI platform for generating and editing video and images with its own Gen models and third-party models, used by creators, agencies and film studios. Its website has moved from runwayml.com to runway.com. The Free plan ($0) gives 125 one-time credits; Standard is $12/month billed annually ($15 monthly) with 625 credits and Pro $28/month billed annually, with Team and Enterprise plans.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The Free plan ($0) gives 125 one-time credits; Standard is $12/month billed annually ($15 monthly) with 625 credits and Pro $28/month billed annually, with Team and Enterprise plans.

features: AI Video Editing: Provides tools for background removal, color grading, and face blurring.
Text-to-Video Generation: Generates videos from static images or text prompts using the Gen-3 Alpha model.
Real-Time Collaboration: Allows multiple users to work simultaneously on a single project.
Comprehensive Media Tools: Offers a suite of tools for generating and manipulating images, audio, and 3D assets.
